description: Defines the AddressTrackerLinux class responsible for tracking network interface addresses on Linux using rtnetlink, including constructors, initialization, callbacks, and internal message handling.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages tracking of network interface addresses and online links on Linux, with support for callbacks on changes, and internal message handling via netlink.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux::AddressTrackerAutoLock
classes.description: Helper class for managing lock acquisition and release in tracking mode.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Default constructor for non-tracking mode, takes a snapshot of current system configuration.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for tracking mode, sets callbacks, ignored interfaces, and optional blocking thread runner.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Starts watching system configuration for changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes with a provided file descriptor for testing.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns current address map; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns set of online interface indices; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetAddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Returns pointer to self, for internal use.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns current AddressMap and online links, and starts diff recording; callable on any thread.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called on address/link changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type, blocking until initialization completes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns interface name given its index.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterfaceName
methods.description: Checks if interface name refers to a tunnel.
